{{Top|leg}}
The '''Museum of the Absolutes''' was created as a memorial to the atrocities committed by the [[Absolutes]]. It was located in the [[Civilized sector]] of [[New Apsolon (city)|New Apsolon]]. The museum was based in the former headquarters of the Absolutes and many of the [[Torture/Legends|torture]] cells and devices were still intact. Tour guides to the museum were former prisoners of the Absolutes.
